sections.appearance: She has pale blonde, long hair reaching to her waist with side bun on her left side. She has emerald green eyes. Halo ==== Nonomi's halo has a neon green circle with another smaller circle inside and has 2 earlaps. Uniform ==== She dons the Abydos uniform but forgoes the tie and blazer and instead wears a white shirt under a beige cardigan with black piping loosely off her shoulders. The Abydos access badge hangs around her neck on a lanyard, grey skirt, a pair of black socks and white trainers Her hands are covered with black tracking gloves and an Abydos access badge wrapped around her neck. Item: She has a green, hooded bank robber's hat with the number three on it. For her young version, Nonomi wears a neat and formal school uniform. It consists of a dark navy blue blazer with thin light-blue piping along the lapels and pockets, worn over a black vest, a white collared dress shirt, and a vibrant cyan-blue tie. She pairs this with a dark gray pleated plaid skirt featuring subtle grid patterns, solid black tights, and classic gray loafer shoes. Her long ash-blonde hair is styled with a side bun on the left, and she retains her bright yellow halo above her head. She is also seen carrying a large, heavy black equipment bag slung over her shoulder, presumably containing her minigun. Firearm ==== thumb|Little Machine Gun V She uses a black and white M134 "Minigun" with hints of green painted in some parts of the gun. A 'chainsaw grip' is attached above the receiver for hip-fire

sections.personality: She has an emotional and gentle personality, and serves as a mental support for the Committee, many of whom have extreme personalities. Although she hasn't said it herself, she is the daughter of a very rich family, and most of the snacks for the Council come out from her allowance.
